influences.name: Jim Vallance
influences.context: I really must give credit to Jim [Vallance, Adams' songwriting partner]. Great teacher. Always would be there to help me filter out the shite.

influences.name: Andrew Catlin
influences.context: From then on I worked with Andrew Catlin who had a very different style of simply being there quietly on his own, camera always on hand

influences.name: Anton Corbijn
influences.context: And I worked with the brilliant Anton Corbijn whose work was not only in camera, but in the darkroom. He introduced me to my printers in the early days, and turned my lacklustre negatives into something I was proud of
